selectionProvenance.selectionRule: Selected existing water pixels have B >= G + 5 and B >= R + 18 inside the original conservative water regions. A separate authored exclusion removes the full fir silhouette near x458–469,y105–118. These rules choose a glint domain; source RGB is unchanged.

cloudClip.selectionNote: Independently reviewed cloud-only fixed-y drift domain. Excludes left forest, tree tips and the full mast silhouette. Original static sky-plane ownership is unchanged.

provenance.origin: Project-commissioned SpriteCook source and clean hidden plate; source-exact masked extraction only.
provenance.rights: Existing project-commissioned SpriteCook artwork; original provider assets and metadata remain in the project.
provenance.sourceTransform: No resampling, quantization, colour correction or whole-scene substitution. Provider pixels replace only owned moving selections.

skyPatch.reason: Use an unchanged same-row blank-sky crop from the existing master beneath only the selected cloud pixels; preserve the original colour ramp without colour arithmetic or resampling.

skyDonorCandidate.usage: comparison-only; rejected as a production sky underlay because its exposed lower sky is about20R/15G darker than the master near the selected cloud

localLightReceiverReview.method: R09-only binary white receiver edits on pinned original masks; source-scene RGB and R08 files unchanged.

groundLightDonor.method: Byte-for-byte preservation of the reviewed R09 ground-light donor before the independent R08 PR136 mask update; no resampling, edits or re-encoding.
groundLightDonor.integrationReason: Keep the independently reviewed R09 central-step selection unchanged while retaining main PR136 ground-light mask at its existing R08 path.
